feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 5:44am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind.


##Wind)##

South or S-SE 5 or 6, veering S-SW later this afternoon, then SW tonight.


##State of sea)##

Mostly moderate, occasionally rough in the south.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain &/or drizzle soon clearing to showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind.


##Wind)##

SW 5 or 6 soon decreasing 4 or 5, backing S-SW later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C
##Thursday, 21 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

S-SW 4 or 5, backing SE 3 or 4 later in the day, veering overnight to S'ly 4 occasional 5.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Early rain soon becoming mainly fair, but the risk of coastal mist.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, becoming poor in any coastal mist.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C

##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

South or S-SW 3 or 4, occasional 5 at first, becoming variable 3 or less overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south.


##Weather)##

Mostly fair, but a risk of occasional mist near some coasts.


##Visibility)##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C

11°C

##Warnings)##

Nil.

Variable 3 or less, settling mainly SE 2 to 4 for a while.

Smooth or slight.

Fair.

Good.
